interpretation_ko: 성공과 따뜻한 우정, 모든 장사의 번영, 농부의 풍작을 약속하는 조짐
interpretation_en: as it foretells success and warm friendships. Prosperity to all trades is promised, and the farmer will be blessed with a bounteous harvest

cite.original: Rice is good to see in dreams, as it foretells success and warm friendships. Prosperity to all trades is promised, and the farmer will be blessed with a bounteous harvest.
cite.translation_ko: 쌀을 보는 꿈은, 성공과 따뜻한 우정, 모든 장사의 번영, 농부의 풍작을 약속하는 조짐이다

cite.original: To eat it, signifies happiness and domestic comfort.
cite.translation_ko: 쌀을 먹는 꿈은, 행복과 가정의 안락을 뜻하는 조짐이다

interpretation_en: denotes sickness and separation from friends

cite.original: To see it mixed with dirt or otherwise impure, denotes sickness and separation from friends.
cite.translation_ko: 쌀에 흙이 섞이거나 더러운 꿈은, 병들고 벗과 헤어질 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 새 소임을 맡아 더 행복해지고 부유함을 누릴 조짐
interpretation_en: shows she will soon assume new duties, which will make her happier, and she will enjoy wealth

cite.original: For a young woman to dream of cooking it, shows she will soon assume new duties, which will make her happier, and she will enjoy wealth.
cite.translation_ko: 처녀가 쌀로 밥을 짓는 꿈은, 새 소임을 맡아 더 행복해지고 부유함을 누릴 조짐이다
